sourceNotes.rawContent:
Turn heads with our Red Ruby & Emerald Vine Anti-Tarnish Necklace — a bold gold-plated necklace featuring deep red ruby oval CZ stones nestled between vibrant emerald green leaf accents in a graceful V-shaped vine design. Rich, regal, and effortlessly glamorous — this necklace is made for women who love classic colour with a modern twist.
- 💛 Gold-plated with anti-tarnish coating
- ❤️ Deep red ruby oval CZ + emerald green leaf stones
- 🌿 Elegant V-shaped vine pendant design
- 🔗 Delicate gold chain with secure clasp
- 🎁 Perfect for festivals, weddings & gifting
Pairs beautifully with: Red, green, or ivory ethnic wear — sarees, lehengas, and anarkalis.
